title: Deep generative models for ligand-based de novo design applied to multi-parametric optimization.
summary: Eleven proposed molecules were synthesized and assayed across multiple objectives, outperforming starting compounds on objective counts. The abstract supports lead optimization, not therapeutic efficacy.
ai_technology: Deep generative molecular design coupled to trained QSAR models
